description: Save text as a new draft in Postel, optionally with images or videos downloaded from public URLs and a LinkedIn first comment (up to 1250 characters). Does not publish or schedule. Each call creates a separate draft.

firstComment.description: LinkedIn only: comment posted under the post right after it is published. Max 1250 characters.

mediaUrls.description: Public image or video URLs to download and attach (max 4). X: up to 4 images, or one video or GIF. LinkedIn: images, or one video.

items.description: Public http(s) URL of an image or video

name: create-post
title: Create draft post
